title: コモンズ・展示台
description: 黒皮鋼の円柱とシアンの発光リム。展示物や小型作品を載せられる独立した台座。
descriptionEn: A blackened-steel cylindrical plinth with a cyan emissive rim for displays and small exhibits.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original procedural cafe geometry with original AI-generated material images
provenance.rights: Xenoah original assets. On 2026-10-14 the owner requested their publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party model, SDK, vehicle, font or poster is included.
provenance.changes: Selected original meshes extracted; chamfers evaluated; pivot centered at base; meter scale and Y-up retained; original PNG bytes and mirror/clamp sampling preserved. Unity behaviors omitted.

uv: Original UVs; architectural materials use mirrored repeat, panel artwork uses clamp. STL has no colors or UVs. Not validated for 3D printing.
